text:
maya: heads-up — mobile customers reporting 413s from /v1/embeddings. payloads ~1.1-1.4MB, dims vary widely. console shows a spike of rejects. anyone on call? :eyes:

sam: seen a few of these in staging earlier. i suspected the splitter but logs looked like unit quota rejections not nginx body-size.

eli: i pulled a trace for one of the requests — nginx returned 413, but our ingress logs show downstream abort with 'units_exceeded'. weird ordering.

maya: exact request from mobile (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Content-Type: application/json
X-Embed-Units: 1240
{
  "model":"embed-small",
  "inputs":[ /* ~1800 short texts */ ]
}
```

jess: quick reminder — current policy is: reject-by-bytes at the edge first (2MB limit), then unit calc fallback. but console preflight recently introduced an 'early-units' path that short-circuits for big dim variance. could be a race.

sam: do we have telemetry that correlates nginx 413s with our unit rejections? last week we saw mismatch where client got 413 but our metrics had 0 bytes rejects.

eli: i created a small query: `sum by (reason) (increase(ingress_rejects_total[1h]))` shows both `bytes_limit` and `units_quota` rising in the same minute for the tenant. looks like dual checks failing on different layers.

maya: mobile payloads are chunked-ish — some entries have huge dim arrays (dense vectors alongside text), so units calc spikes. mobile SDK currently doesn't set a shape header.

jess: can we add short-term console hint to show 'likely cause: units vs bytes' in the rejection modal? right now support gets a 413 with no direction.

sam: +1. also propose adding diagnostic headers on rejects: `X-Embed-Reject: bytes|units|ingress` and `X-Embed-Estimate: 1240` so SDKs can act.

ops-bot: Note: created ticket INF-8231 for "embed reject diagnostic headers" and assigned to @jess.

eli: implementation note — the tricky part is header ordering. nginx will return 413 before our app headers if body is too large at the L7 buffer. to surface our reason we need to move the bytes check into app or do a small probe before large payloads. both have tradeoffs.

maya: short-term workaround for mobile: add client-side preflight estimating units and early-split if estimate > 1000 units. SDK patch is small. longer term we want console + server headers.

jess: ok i'll scope console change: add a small tooltip and sample cURL in the reject card that recommends `--split-by-units` for oversized unit estimates. can we get a sample text blurb?

sam: sample: "If you see 413 & large unit estimates, try splitting requests by estimated units or reduce dims per item. See console docs -> Embeddings payload guide."

eli: i'll prototype adding `X-Embed-Reject` on our app-side rejects and a fallback spike detector for nginx 413s to attach probable reason via support logs.

maya: thanks. timeline? mobile is hitting this in prod right now so would prefer a quick SDK doc + console tooltip within 24-48h, headers/probe next sprint.

jess: ack. i'll push tooltip + docs PR today.

sam: i'll open a tiny SDK PR with preflight estimator and fail-fast split example.

eli: i'll PR the server header change and the support-log enhancer for nginx 413s next week.

maya: thanks team :thumbsup: if anything changes i'll post updates here.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-8231 updated: status -> in_progress.
